title: 95. 5 Skills to Regulate Your Emotions, Decrease Emotional Vulnerability, + Build Your Life Worth Living
description_html: Today's solo episode is all about the emotion regulation module of DBT (dialectical behavioral therapy). I dive into everything you need to know to decrease your emotional vulnerability, effectively cope with emotions that arise and improve regulation long-term. Skills/topics mentioned include building your life worth living, understanding your priorities/values so you can live in line with them, ABC PLEASE skills, mindfulness of current emotions, and changing emotional responses.

summary: sadie breaks down the emotion regulation module of dbt, focusing on five key skills to help you manage emotions day-to-day and build a life worth living. she covers the please skill (taking care of your body to support your mind), the abc skill (accumulating positives, building mastery, and coping ahead), mindfulness of current emotions, and changing emotional responses through check the facts and opposite action. this is a practical, skill-heavy episode for anyone wanting to decrease emotional vulnerability and feel more in control long-term.
